title: Hazel and the Hymn
author: Gideon Dravenmoor
blurb: Isandro Whitlock, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
